name: StudentMastery
description: Schema representing a student's mastery record for a specific Standard Pembelajaran (SP).

mastery_percentage.description: Calculated mastery percentage (0-100) based on assessments, widgets, and mission performance.

attempts.description: Total number of recorded attempts across lessons, quizzes, and widgets.

confidence_level.description: Calculated confidence level based on consistency and accuracy.

last_attempt.description: Timestamp of the most recent interaction with this SP.

first_completed.description: Timestamp when the SP first transitioned to MASTERED status.

time_spent.description: Total active learning time spent on this SP in seconds.

streak.description: Current consecutive correct answers or successful mission completions.

recommended_revision.description: SP codes dynamically recommended for revision if mastery drops or is insufficient.

recommended_next.description: SP codes recommended next once mastery is achieved.
